# FDG4021

> CONSIDER defining an interface if you need to support its functionality on types that already inherit from some other type.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 4.6 Interface Design.

## How it is checked

- Check: judgment
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library suggestion, application suggestion, test none
- Status: draft

A design choice; not machine-checkable.
